pages.text:
The Fermenter turns crops and water into Ethanol, using a little power.
| Crop | Ethanol |
| Wheat, Potato, Carrot, Beetroot | 50 mB |
| Sugar Cane | 60 mB |
| Sweet Berries | 25 mB |
| Melon Slice | 20 mB |
Each takes 100 mB of water and 10 s, and has a 10% chance to leave Bone Meal. Speed and Energy upgrades work.
# Ethanol
A light fuel: 300 HU per mB at up to 900°C in the Fuel Burner (Naphtha is 400 HU at 1,200°C). It also runs the Gas Turbine Array.
